Public-site teacher capture lane

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --sites SITES         Comma-separated site names (default: all)
  --max-tasks MAX_TASKS
                        Max tasks per site this run
  --no-propose          Disable proposer-generated tasks; run only curated
                        config tasks
  --parallel PARALLEL   Concurrent site sandboxes
  --traj-dir TRAJ_DIR
  --config CONFIG       Path to a sites JSON (default: public_sites.json)
